viewer: New-car buyers in 2026 financing about $35,000 through a bank and torn between a 60-month and a 72-month loan.
decision: Take the 72-month loan for the lower payment, or stick with 60 months?
promise: Using years of real bank auto-loan rates, we measure how much the longer loan really adds and whether the rate or the time drives it.
title: 60 vs 72 Months on a $35,000 Car Loan: The Real Cost
